package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
)

// scenario for binary_read_for_single_field: `binary.Read(r, order, &singleField)` for reading a single integer
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario440Positive(data []byte) (uint32, error) {
	r := bytes.NewReader(data)
	var val uint32
	err := binary.Read(r, binary.BigEndian, &val)
	return val, err
}
